title: Assistant Territory Manager - Prakasam
jobDescription:
About Agro Star:

Agro Star is India’s foremost Agri-tech company with a mission of #Helping Farmers Win. Shardul and Sitanshu started Agro Star with a vision to solve two of the biggest problems in Indian agriculture - Lack of guidance for scientific/sustainable farming & limited access to great-quality farm inputs.


Today, Agro Star Group provides full-stack solutions to millions of farmers across 9 Indian states via an omnichannel approach. Along the journey, we have built India’s largest agronomy advisory center powered by 400+ agri graduates, a highly engaged digital farmer network with over 7 million users and the highest-rated agri app, and a retail network of 7300+ stores. These technology-enabled channels help farmers produce better and achieve higher price realizations by providing appropriate advice, timely input delivery, and output market linkages.


In March 2022, Agro Star forayed into the output space by acquiring INI farms. With this acquisition, Agro Star Group is Helping Farmers Win with better price realization across 10+ crops by exporting high-quality F&V under the brand name ‘Kimaye’ to 25+ countries across the globe. With 1500+ employees, Agro Star group believes in a culture of ownership and high growth and has been a recipient of multiple Best Startups to Work awards. You can deep dive into our culture here.


With massive synergies across the value chain to unlock, we are excited about our next exponential growth phase while being more mission-focused than ever!


Role Overview:


At Agro Star, an Assistant Territory Manager plays a crucial role in driving the company’s revenue, managing teams, communicating our value proposition, and ensuring effective channel development and management within the defined territory. He/She is responsible for achieving sales targets, training teams, tracking performance, and providing valuable insights for business planning.

Roles & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive revenue and growth by achieving sales targets for our Agri-Inputs business across categories like Seeds, Crop Protection, Crop Nutrition, and Farm Implements in the defined territory.

  • Analyze market trends and conduct market research to identify growth opportunities in your territory

  • Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure successful marketing campaigns and drive demand.

  • Supervise Sales Managers and Expansion Managers to drive revenue and Saathi partner onboarding

  • Regularly monitor progress, analyze data, and generate reports to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement for your team

  • Work with and train the Saathi partners on product placement of Agro Star products in their outlets.

  • Establish short- and long-term goals for the territory and strategies to achieve the same,

  • Responsible for Collections from the Saathi partners

  • Collate and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on time.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Graduation in BSc Agriculture or a related field is mandatory

  • Should have at least 4+ years of Sales experience in the Agriculture industry.

  • Ability to multitask

  • Clear, effective decision-making with an emphasis on a data-driven approach.

  • Microsoft Office skills (Power Point, Excel).

  • Should have managed a sales team before

  • Must have complete knowledge of the local areas of the District

  • Should be open to travel at least 60% to 80 % of the time with a limited overnight stay.


Most importantly, we are looking for passionate entrepreneurs who want to work at the grassroots level, drive impact in India’s biggest sector, and help Farmers Win!


A bit more about us:

  • The Agro Star Solution- an overview.

  • Agro Star Last-Mile Delivery- from the lens of our partner, Brijesh Thakkar

  • An orange farmer’s story- Shri. Anil Deshmukh - Amravati, Maharashtra

  • Sowing Seeds of Sustainability- Agro Star Sustainability Report (ESG)

  • CNBC Startup Street- Interview with Shardul Sheth

  • Series D Announcement - USD 70 Mn

  • INI acquisition - establishing output market linkage vertical

These technology-enabled channels help farmers produce better and achieve higher price realizations by providing appropriate advice, timely input delivery, and output market linkages.


In March 2022, Agro Star forayed into the output space by acquiring INI farms. With this acquisition, Agro Star Group is Helping Farmers Win with better price realization across 10+ crops by exporting high-quality F&V under the brand name ‘Kimaye’ to 25+ countries across the globe. With 1500+ employees, Agro Star group believes in a culture of ownership and high growth and has been a recipient of multiple Best Startups to Work awards. You can deep dive into our culture here.


With massive synergies across the value chain to unlock, we are excited about our next exponential growth phase while being more mission-focused than ever!


Roles & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Serve as a knowledgeable resource on agri-input products, including seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and farming tools to our farmers.

  2. Build and maintain strong relationships with farmers, fostering trust and loyalty.

  3. Proactively make outbound calls to farmers and recommend appropriate products and practices based on farmers' needs and purchasing capacity.

  4. Sell agri-input products directly to farmers, using your agri knowledge and communication skills, and boost sales.

  5. Follow up with customers after sales to ensure satisfaction, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.

  6. Continuously strive to enhance your product knowledge and sales techniques through training and self-improvement initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  1. Diploma, Bachelor's or Master's degree in agriculture, agronomy, horticulture, or a related field.

  2. Freshers can apply, prior experience is an advantage

  3. Fluency in speaking and understanding the local language

  4. Result-driven mindset with a focus on achieving sales targets
